description: This source file appears to be part of a Git implementation, dealing with object reachability, traversal, and progress reporting related to Git objects such as commits, trees, blobs, and tags. It contains functions for adding objects to the traversal, marking objects as reachable, handling recent and rebase-related objects, and reporting progress during traversal.

classes.name: connectivity_progress
classes.description: Tracks the progress of connectivity traversal, including a progress indicator and count.

classes.name: recent_data
classes.description: Holds data related to recent objects, including revision info, timestamps, callback functions, and object sets.

methods.name: void update_progress(struct connectivity_progress * cp)
methods.description: Updates the progress display at regular intervals during traversal.

methods.name: void add_one_file(const char * path,struct rev_info * revs)
methods.description: Reads a file containing an object ID and marks the corresponding object as pending for traversal.

methods.name: void add_rebase_files(struct rev_info * revs)
methods.description: Adds objects from rebase state files (autostash, orig-head, etc.) to the traversal.

methods.name: int add_one_ref(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Adds a referenced object to the traversal, handling dangling symbolic refs.

methods.name: void mark_object(struct object * obj UNUSED,const char * name UNUSED,void * data)
methods.description: Marks an object as seen and updates progress.

methods.name: void mark_commit(struct commit * c,void * data)
methods.description: Marks a commit object as seen.

methods.name: void load_gc_recent_objects(struct recent_data * data)
methods.description: Loads additional recent objects specified by gc.recentobjectshook configuration.

methods.name: int obj_is_recent(const struct object_id * oid,timestamp_t mtime,struct recent_data * data)
methods.description: Checks if an object is considered recent based on timestamp or additional recent object set.

methods.name: void add_recent_object(const struct object_id * oid,struct packed_git * pack,off_t offset,timestamp_t mtime,struct recent_data * data)
methods.description: Adds a recent object to the traversal, parsing depending on object type.

methods.name: int want_recent_object(struct recent_data * data,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Determines whether an object should be considered recent and included in traversal based on various criteria.

methods.name: int add_recent_loose(const struct object_id * oid,const char * path,void * data)
methods.description: Adds a loose object to traversal if it is recent.

methods.name: int add_recent_packed(const struct object_id * oid,struct packed_git * p,uint32_t pos,void * data)
methods.description: Adds a packed object to traversal if it is recent, considering packmtime.

methods.name: int add_unseen_recent_objects_to_traversal(struct rev_info * revs,timestamp_t timestamp,report_recent_object_fn * cb,int ignore_in_core_kept_packs)
methods.description: Main entry point for adding recent objects (loose and packed) to the traversal.

methods.name: int mark_object_seen(const struct object_id * oid,enum object_type type,int exclude UNUSED,uint32_t name_hash UNUSED,struct packed_git * found_pack UNUSED,off_t found_offset UNUSED,void * payload UNUSED)
methods.description: Marks an object as seen during bitmap traversal.

methods.name: void mark_reachable_objects(struct rev_info * revs,int mark_reflog,timestamp_t mark_recent,struct progress * progress)
methods.description: Orchestrates the process of marking all reachable objects in a Git repository, including refs, reflogs, recent objects, and progress reporting.
